name: PhD in Public Administration
intro: A list of all substantial courses which I attended as part of my doctoral studies.

courses.title: Methods of Organizational and Administrative Research
notes: One of my outputs in this course was an [analysis of how Michael Kaeding used Lieberman's "nested analysis" approach to mixed methods in his doctoral thesis](/uploads/2009/07/THAPA-Kaeding-as-Mixed-Method-Role-Model.pdf).

place: Universität Potsdam · DFG Research Training Group

name: Master of Arts Public Policy & Management
intro: A list of all substantial courses which I attended during my graduate studies at Universität Potsdam from 2010 to 2013.

courses.title: Business Systems and Varieties of Capitalism
notes: As part of the course, I produced a [handout on convergence among multi-national enterprises](/uploads/THAPA-Varieties-of-Capitalism.pdf) (German).

courses.title: Denationalization and Privatisation: Institutional Change in the Public Sector
notes: As part of this course, I produced a [presentation on privatization of water services](/uploads/THAPA-Privatisierung-der-Wasserversorgung.pdf) (German).

courses.title: Public Management A
notes: As part of the lecture, I produced a [case study on change management](/uploads/THAPA-Fallstudie-Change-Management.pdf) and a [presentation on public accounting systems](/uploads/THAPA-Oeffentliches-Rechnungswesen.pdf) (both in German).

courses.title: Government and Governance in Developing Countries
Training Research Project on Case Studies in Public Management
notes: As part of the course, I produced a [presentation on multi-case study research](/uploads/THAPA-Ragin-Turning-the-Tables.pdf) (in German).
My group explored the use of key performance indicators with Berlin's police.

courses.title: Introduction to Institutional Ethnography
notes: As an exercise, I conducted an institutional ethnography of [Stiftung Nord-Süd-Brücken](http://www.nord-sued-bruecken.de/english.html)'s small-scale grant selection committee.

courses.title: Consulting Practice in Public Management
notes: A mock consulting job for []init[ AG](http://www.init.de/en), where my group conducted a study on mobile citizen services in German municipalities.

courses.title: Influencing the Policy Process: actors, instruments, legitimacy
notes: As part of the seminar, I produced a [presentation on associations as interest groups](/uploads/THAPA-Interessenvertretung-durch-Verbaende.pdf) (in German).

courses.title: Current Topics of E-Government
notes: As part of the seminar, I produced a [presentation on apps and portals in m-government](/uploads/THAPA-Portal-oder-Apps-M-Government-Praesentation.pdf) (in German).

courses.title: Financial markets from the perspective of (economic) sociology
Qualitative Methods: Interviews, Text Analysis and Observation
notes: As part of the seminar, I produced a [presentation on participant observation](/uploads/THAPA-Participant-Observation.pdf).

name: Bachelor of Arts Political Science & Economics
intro: A list of all substantial courses which I attended during my undergraduate studies at WWU Münster.

courses.title: Political System of the Federal Republic of Germany
notes: As part of the course, I produced a [presentation on Ernst Fraenkel’s structural analysis of modern democracy](/uploads/Praesentation-Fraenkel.pdf) (in German).

courses.title: Comparative Political Science
notes: As part of the lecture, I wrote a [short analysis of China's political system from a rational-choice institutionalism point of view](/uploads/Thapa-Abstract-China-Institutionalismus.pdf) (in German).

courses.title: Emerging Markets and Economic Growth in Subsahara Africa
notes: As part of the seminar, I produced a [presentation on Ghana as a development dictatorship](/uploads/Praesentation-Ghana-als-Entwicklungsdiktatur.pdf) (in German).

courses.title: Social Policy
notes: As part of the seminar, I wrote an [essay on dual hospital financing in the German health system](/uploads/Thapa-Sozialpolitik.pdf) (in German).

courses.title: Microfinance and International Finance: Poverty Alleviation and Empowerment II
Modeling and Simulation: Software-supported Analysis
notes: In the seminar, we simulated the Darfur conflict using the system simulation software [Vensim](http://vensim.com/).

courses.title: Transatlantic Governance and Regulation of the (Subprime) Financial Crisis
Welfare Systems in Europe
notes: As part of the course, I wrote an [essay on parental benefits in Sweden](/uploads/Essay-Elterngeld-Schweden-Thapa.pdf) (German)

courses.title: Business Cycles and Employment
notes: Here is [my part of a group paper on the Dutch polder model in labour policy](/uploads/Thapa-Poldermodell-Niederlande-Anteil.pdf) (German).

courses.title: Introduction to Development Cooperation
notes: As part of the course, I wrote an [essay on the organisation of German bilateral development cooperation](/uploads/Klausur-Essay-Entwicklungspolitik-Thapa.pdf) (German)

courses.title: Crisis and Regulation in Global Financial Markets
Behavioral Economics
notes: For the seminar, I produced a [presentation about homo economicus, its empirical anomalies, and alternative economic theories of behavior](/uploads/THAPA-Oekonomischer-Imperialismus1.pdf)
